purpose: Independently re-run the sham-retirement and maintenance-requalification gates after excluding concurrent-campaign and interrupted-step data.
allocation: same fresh GPU0 allocation; one exclusive lock; separate MPS epochs for the two gates
operational_requalification: fresh 200-release D35 conventional-only test, zero misses required before any gate

sham_retirement.success: all correct, all 10000 releases have zero deadline misses and no optional work was submitted

maintenance_requalification.success: each fault times out and drains, then all 6000 fresh conventional releases are correct with zero deadline misses

interpretation_limit: A measured zero-miss run is not a universal deadline proof; any observed miss must be reported, including if the sham has no submitted optional work.
